themes.label: Funerary Inscriptions (Epitaphs)
themes.rationale: The inscription consists of a single personal name in the nominative case, which is the standard format for a simple funerary marker or gravestone in the region of Tanagra.

themes.label: Tombstone (Gravestone)
themes.rationale: Based on the content (a single name) and the archaeological context of Tanagra, this text was originally inscribed on a funerary monument such as a stele or a small stone block.

themes.label: Fragmentary
themes.rationale: The use of square brackets around the initial sigma indicates that the beginning of the name is missing or damaged on the physical support and has been restored by the editor.

rationale: This is a brief funerary inscription from Tanagra, Boeotia. It records the name of a woman, Sosikleia. The restoration of the first letter suggests the stone has suffered some surface damage or breakage at the left margin. Such single-name inscriptions are extremely common in the cemeteries of Tanagra.
